This keeps the pinned Three.js revision and works with classic scripts under `file://`, where native ES module loading is blocked. `dashboard/js/core-glb-data.js` embeds the asset bytes because standard Chrome blocks XHR/fetch to sibling file URLs from the page opaque origin; GLTFLoader.parse handles the exact core.glb payload.
